Assessment of BA.evidence_source: Finally, a study of British adults found that connectedness to nature was directly associated with body appreciation–operationalised using the Body Appreciation Scale (BAS; Avalos, Tylka, & Wood-Barcalow, 2005), a measure of positive body image – in women (r = .32) but not in men (r = .10; Swami, von Nordheim, et al., 2016).

section_summary.extract_value: This introduction section reviews existing literature on the health-promoting qualities of natural environments, discussing theories like Psychophysiological Stress Recovery Theory and Attention Restoration Theory. It also explores the concept of connectedness to nature and its links to well-being and body image. One specific study (Swami, von Nordheim, et al., 2016), referred to as Study X, is mentioned, which investigated the association between connectedness to nature and body appreciation using the BAS in British adults.
